body:
Coverage audit. The owner asked whether every issue raised by the four reviewers had actually been filed. It had not. I went back through all four reports line by line and found EIGHT findings I had summarised in conversation but never turned into beads. Filing them closes the gap; recording the miss because a review that reports findings it never files is worse than one that finds less.

WHAT WAS MISSING, and why each slipped:

  bd-01KZYAPHG7H569TNBPE4XV8WXN  output rows and columns are never labelled, and no vignette
    ever states a finding. The vignette reviewer ranked this THIRD, above the vocabulary
    problem, on the grounds that it blocks a reader even after everything else is fixed. I had
    folded a fragment of it into the copy-paste bead as a secondary note and lost the ranking.
  bd-01KZYARD5697TRN2Q3S0E153BM  33 of 78 exports appear in no vignette; no ?effectagram page;
    no glossary. I filed the generator half of this and dropped the enumeration.
  bd-01KZYAV8X93BX4VC13Z8PK8XRH  the two API changes that actually shorten the path, 7 calls to
    5. I filed tiering and error messages and never filed the call-count work, which is the part
    that answers the adoption comparison.
  bd-01KZYAV952F3MJFDWR43FH8XTV  rdm and rsa should accept a crossnobis plan. The field reviewer
    RAISED this to their number two after measuring the incumbent and called it the strongest
    head-to-head win available. I reported it in conversation and never filed it.
  bd-01KZYBHK443QQD1NW844G1HXZF  no summary, no plot, no coercion off effect_geometry, and the
    svec unpacker is unexported so the escape hatch dead-ends.
  bd-01KZYBHKN8WYBVYCSJ4Z8HMZE8  4 of 11 README blocks do not run; the crossnobis block
    references five objects defined nowhere, in a fence visually identical to the runnable one.
  bd-01KZYBK4TPEQZ95V1TKG5WKC0N  the naming audit. The pattern is the finding: every name that
    passes is one an fMRI person already owns, and every framework noun sits ON THE PATH BETWEEN
    them, so a user learns five invented nouns to connect ten familiar ones.
  bd-01KZYBK55CR0T97SE36G9ESPNP  the unequal-axis example never calls the engine and promises a
    nuisance-column feature the code omits.

Board is now 25 open, 22 tagged effectagram, 20 in this workstream.

TWO OF THESE CHANGE THE PICTURE RATHER THAN JUST COMPLETING IT.

The crossnobis-plan-to-RDM branch is the strongest competitive move identified anywhere in this review and I had it sitting in conversation only. rsatoolbox does it in one call; rMVPA cannot do it through its ordinary RSA verb at all; effectagram is one branch in R/views.R:104-108 away from matching rsatoolbox on the exact quantity an rsatoolbox user arrives looking for, while already beating rMVPA on surfacing. That belongs on the board, not in a summary.

And the naming pattern reframes the vocabulary work. I had been treating naming as churn to be deferred behind tiering. It is that, but the reviewer sharper observation is that the framework nouns are load-bearing for NAVIGATION even where they are not load-bearing for SEMANTICS - they sit exactly on the path between the domain words that already work. That is why the package feels harder than it measures.

PROCESS NOTE. This is the fourth correction I have recorded in this workstream and the first that is a process failure rather than a wrong claim. The other three were things I asserted without measuring. This one is the reverse - things I measured, reported accurately in conversation, and then failed to persist. Different failure, same net effect: the board did not reflect the evidence.
